name: [Template] ETL: Salesforce to PostgreSQL Daily Sync

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Name, Email, Phone, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate >= YESTERDAY

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO contacts (salesforce_id, name, email, phone, created_at, last_modified_at, synced_at)
VALUES
{{ $input.all().map(item => `('${item.json.salesforce_id}', '${item.json.name.replace(/'/g, "''")}', ${item.json.email ? "'" + item.json.email + "'" : 'NULL'}, ${item.json.phone ? "'" + item.json.phone + "'" : 'NULL'}, '${item.json.created_at}', '${item.json.last_modified_at}', '${item.json.synced_at}')`).join(',\n') }}
ON CONFLICT (salesforce_id) 
DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  email = EXCLUDED.email,
  phone = EXCLUDED.phone,
  last_modified_at = EXCLUDED.last_modified_at,
  synced_at = EXCLUDED.synced_at;
